title: Five Places to Dine in Paris With the Author of ‘Let’s Eat France’
abstract: The 16th arrondissement is turning into a dining destination. François-Régis Gaudry, the popular food writer and radio host, offers compelling reasons to eat in the neighborhood.

title: She Owns the Boutique Bird. These Are Her 5 Places to Shop in Los Angeles.
abstract: Until just recently, Jen Mankins had an outpost of her popular store in Los Angeles County. Here are her favorite places to shop there.
